fields.Name: Predictive Studio: Capability Coverage Judge
fields.Description: Decides, per objective in a client's own strategy document, whether a shortlisted signal actually MEASURES it and whether a shortlisted finding says anything about it. The second half of a deliberate two-stage design: embedding similarity shortlists candidates and is measurably unable to tell coverage from coincidence (on live data an objective about a parking-structure lease outranked one about member engagement), so relevance is judged from the candidates' own prose instead. The judge chooses only among candidates retrieval already found and cannot invent a signal; the structural half of each verdict — whether a signal or a finding exists at all — is enforced in code afterwards, so a persuasive sentence cannot collapse the two axes. Anything malformed degrades to Undetermined rather than to a guess.
